title: The Pebble with a Ring
youtube_title: The Pebble with a Ring | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Yuri finds a pebble with a white ring all the way around. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Yuri shows Paz how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
